title: Miller, Keller & Stryker (1989), Swindale (1980) & Hubel, Wiesel & LeVay (1977) Correlation-Based Hebbian Ocular Dominance Stripes & Critical-Period Monocular Deprivation Plasticity in Macaque Primary Visual Cortex (V1 Layer IVC)

primary_papers.citation: Miller KD, Keller JB, Stryker MP (1989) Ocular dominance column development: analysis and simulation. Science 245(4918):605-615
Hubel DH, Wiesel TN, LeVay S (1977) Plasticity of ocular dominance columns in monkey striate cortex. Phil. Trans. R. Soc. Lond. B 278(961):377-409
Swindale NV (1980) A model for the formation of ocular dominance stripes. Proc. R. Soc. Lond. B 208(1171):243-264
Stryker MP, Harris WA (1986) Binocular impulse blockade prevents the formation of ocular dominance columns in cat visual cortex. J. Neurosci. 6(8):2117-2133

governing_equations.synaptic_sum_and_difference_modes: S_Sigma(x) = S^L(x) + S^R(x),   S_Delta(x) = S^L(x) - S^R(x)
governing_equations.hebbian_ocular_dominance_pde: dS_Delta/dt = (A * I * C_Delta) * S_Delta - gamma * S_Delta - S_Delta^3 + b_MD
governing_equations.mexican_hat_cortical_interaction: I(r) = exp(-r^2 / (2 * sigma_E^2)) - kappa_I * exp(-r^2 / (2 * sigma_I^2))
governing_equations.fourier_bandpass_filter: K_hat(k) = exp(-0.5 * sigma_E^2 * k^2) - kappa_I * exp(-0.5 * sigma_I^2 * k^2)
governing_equations.characteristic_wavenumber_squared: k_c^2 = 2 * ln(kappa_I * sigma_I^2 / sigma_E^2) / (sigma_I^2 - sigma_E^2),   lambda_c = 2 * pi / k_c

experimental_regimes.description: Normal binocular vision in Macaca mulatta V1 Layer IVC (C_Delta = 0.80, b_MD = 0.0): equal left/right retinal activity correlation drives 50/50 labyrinthine ocular dominance stripes with characteristic wavelength lambda_c ~ 800 um (400 um single-eye column width)

Hubel, Wiesel & LeVay (1977) critical-period monocular deprivation (MD) of Left eye (C_Delta = 0.80, b_MD = -0.36): open Right eye expands across Layer IVC while deprived Left eye stripes shrink into narrow bands and isolated islands (f_L ~ 0.24)

Strabismus / interocular decorrelation (C_LR = -0.25 => C_Delta = 1.25, b_MD = 0.0, sigma_E = 122 um, sigma_I = 244 um): heightened interocular competition sharpens column borders and broadens stripe wavelength to ~895 um while preserving 50/50 eye balance

Stryker & Harris (1986) bilateral intraocular TTX retinal impulse blockade (C_Delta = 0.0, b_MD = 0.0): abolishing correlated retinal spiking makes omega(k) = -gamma < 0 for all k, completely preventing ocular dominance column segregation

Hubel, Wiesel & LeVay (1977) early critical-period reverse suture (C_Delta = 0.80, b_MD = +0.28): opening the deprived Left eye and suturing the Right eye reverses competitive dominance, expanding Left-eye territory to f_L ~ 0.69
